text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soon enough, the day of the Aoi Stakes arrives…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (…I wondered whether this might happen again.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (My ears are abuzz… It didn't feel this way when I debuted.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (The fresh scent of turf carried on the breeze. The beauty of dirt jumping up to dance before scattering. And the hazy, shimmering heat engulfing me.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (Roaring cheers that shake the very ground. Countless tangible sentiments: passion, determination, dreams, aspirations…)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (The tranquil world I once inhabited alone with my nascent wind is now rife with the howling of turbulent gales.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (But strangely enough… I don't mind it.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The horizon I've drifted along, the world I'm meant to blow through…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Teio… Tomorrow is the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I know you'll blow everyone away. You'll be ferocious, thunderous, boisterous.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: So today… I will be more so.
